name: Academy Accreditation - Platform Administrator
description:
Earners of the Databricks Platform Administrator accreditation have demonstrated an ability to describe how to manage and administer the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.

Share your accomplishment on LinkedIn and tag us #DatabricksLearning. We'll be selecting random winners who tag us for Databricks swag. 

EARNING CRITERIA
Successful completion of Platform Administrator accreditation exam.
